name: Paludal-Lament
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a binary sunset, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Around the signal of unknown origin, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on rare flora, exotic matter and biomass are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
